FINDINGS:
The cardiomediastinal silhouette is normal in size and contour. No focal consolidation, pneumothorax or large pleural effusion. Biapical fibronodular pleural thickening/scarring. There is a like deformity of the anterior cortex of the body (lateral view). Negative for retrosternal density.
IMPRESSION:
Buckling deformity of the anterior cortex of the body. Fracture is possible, if high energy was localized to this region. Correlate with focal tenderness. chest, if warranted.
